claims.statement: EEG-BIDS provides a community data and metadata structure intended to make EEG datasets more transparent, reusable, and reproducible.
A 2026 primary study developed lightweight CNNs for automated detection of eye, muscle, and non-physiological artifacts in continuous clinical EEG.

contrary_evidence: Open-source EEG toolchains and device-vendor QC features may make basic artifact detection free.

economics.acquisition_route: One-to-many distribution through EEG device SDKs, neuroscience CROs, and research-data platforms.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 80 device, CRO, or lab accounts at 6000 PLN blended monthly revenue yields 5.8 million PLN ARR by year five and can support founder equity above 5 million PLN without double-counting cash.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 3 founder hours daily for modeling and integration, with expert annotations purchased in bounded batches.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 80-90% gross margin after inference, storage, expert-label acquisition, and integration support.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: a 10000 PLN device integration pays back within a year at 1500 recordings monthly.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis, including the capital figure: 8 PLN per recording or a 1500 PLN monthly SDK minimum.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every new recording, protocol revision, and data-release QC run creates another paid event.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Consented expert corrections across hardware, montages, and protocols improve generalization and calibration
fingerprint.customer: EEG device vendors, neuroscience CROs, and high-throughput research laboratories
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded device SDK and neuroscience workflow integration
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Research-use artifact detection and provenance API sold per recording and SDK minimum
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The platform or laboratory pays when a recording receives a QC result
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A recording must pass quality control before analysis, delivery, or dataset release

founder_fit: This directly leverages the founder's EEG, neuroscience, data-science, and AI background with low capital and asynchronous sales.
risks: The initial product must be labeled research-use-only and must not make diagnostic claims without appropriate medical-device compliance.

structure.control_point: The acceptance gate before an EEG recording enters analysis or a research dataset
structure.critical_dependency: Cross-device validation and explicit rights to expert-labeled signal segments

thesis: Embed automated EEG artifact scoring in device SDKs and research-data platforms, charging for every recording accepted or rejected while accumulating consented expert correction labels across devices.
title: NeuroQC Recording Gate API
uncertainties: Cross-device error rates and buyers' willingness to license correction labels remain unvalidated.
